justify_why_gaps_are_missing.justification: The time axis shows continuous, regularly spaced tick marks (e.g., 0, intermediate values, up to the final time) for each main plot and for the inset zooms; there are no oblique/zig-zag break markers and no abrupt numeric jumps that would indicate an omitted interval.

The normalized intensity axis is continuous with evenly spaced tick labels (range up to 1.0) and no visual break symbols or skipped numeric ranges; inset panels also display continuous intensity scales without discontinuities.
